subject: QuantumHealth trial: readiness checklist, success metrics, and access items
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@quantumhealth.io>; Tom Blake <tom@quantumhealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & trial kickoff checklist (next steps)

Hi Samira/Tom —

Great to meet today. Thanks for walking through QuantumHealth's key use cases; we left the call with clear agreement to run a 4-week trial focused on:

- Latency and throughput for batch claims enrichment (150-400 tokens per request)
- Semantic similarity/embeddings for claim grouping
- Response fidelity on sensitive PHI-styled prompts (synthetic test corpus)

Action items / immediate next steps:
1) Access: we need SSO invites (Okta) for your evaluation team and a list of IP ranges for our temporary IP allowlist.
2) API keys: we'll provision scoped trial API keys with token limits — confirm the primary owner for key rotation below.
3) Success criteria: please confirm two KPIs we should measure: 95th pct token latency < 200ms and embedding recall@10 > 0.82 on the seeded test set.
4) Timeline: target trial window 2026-09-07 -> 2026-10-05 (4 weeks).

I've attached a one-page success matrix and a short ops guide for the trial. Marissa — can you own the onboarding SSO invite and coordinate IP allowlist with Aditya? Aditya — we'll need a short-lived API key and a sandbox project created by 2026-09-04.

Samira — please reply with the names/emails for Okta invites and the CIDR ranges you can provide for the allowlist. Also flag any compliance constraints (e.g. no shared logs outside your VPC).

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Sr. AE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: quantumhealth_poc_success_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_trial_instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Samira Patel <samira@quantumhealth.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom@quantumhealth.io>; trial-ops@quantumhealth.io
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & trial kickoff checklist (next steps)

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming QuantumHealth will proceed with the 4-week trial. A few notes and answers below: 

- Okta invites: please invite these pilot users: Samira Patel (samira@quantumhealth.io), Josh Meyer (josh.meyer@quantumhealth.io), Priya Singh (priya.singh@quantumhealth.io).
- IP allowlist: our infra team can provide short-term ranges: 52.23.144.0/22 and 3.234.0.0/16 — can you confirm these are granular enough?
- Owners: Tom Blake (tom@quantumhealth.io) will be primary owner for API keys and approvals. Trial-ops will be the escalation channel.
- Compliance: we cannot allow PII or raw PHI outside our environment. We will provide a synthetic test corpus for fidelity checks; please ensure logs are not retained beyond the trial (or mask them).

We appreciate the attachments — reviewing now. One request: can Redwood provide a scoped key that only allows calls to the "/v1/generate" and "/v1/embeddings" endpoints and has a 10,000 token/day limit?

Regards,
Samira
Director, Data Products
QuantumHealth

Thanks Samira — clear and helpful. Quick replies inline: 

- IP ranges: yes, those CIDRs work. We'll add them to the temporary allowlist for the trial window and share the confirmed list once applied.
- Scoped key: yes — we can issue a scoped trial key limited to the two endpoints and set a 10k token/day soft limit. That key will be issued to Tom (tom@quantumhealth.io) unless you prefer a team mailbox.
- Logs & PHI: Redwood will configure no persistent request logging for this trial (we will still record aggregated telemetry for latency/error metrics). We'll also ensure any retained prompt traces are redacted per your compliance note. I'll loop Legal if we need anything formal.

Marissa + Aditya: please confirm the Okta invites are sent and the scoped trial key is created by EOD 2026-09-04. Also, Marissa — can you drop the SSO invite link and the temporary API key rotation policy in this thread once done?

Samira — attaching the success matrix and a short checklist for your infra team.

Cheers,
Neha

All — owning the onboarding steps. Quick status:

- IP allowlist: applied the two ranges Samira provided. We had one minor routing rule; that's cleared now.
- Scoped API key: Aditya created the scoped trial key (token id: sk-trial-qh-8a3f). Details sent to Tom via encrypted email (Tom acknowledged). Key policy: endpoints allowed: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings; soft daily token cap 10,000; auto-expire 2026-10-06 00:00:00Z.
- Docs: uploaded redwood_trial_instructions.pdf and the success matrix to the shared Drive link (see related_links).

Next operational asks: 
- Samira/Tom: confirm the test-corpus delivery by 2026-09-03 so we can seed evaluation runs before the trial start.
- Tom: confirm the recipient for encrypted key delivery in case we need rotation during the window.

I'll follow up tomorrow with the SSO join link and a short checklist for your engineering lead.

Marissa Cole
